sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: road signs: warning, regulatory, construction, destination, service, mile marker, route number and railroad crossing signs
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The signs chapter is a picture gallery; only the printed sign descriptions were used, and text that appears only inside sign pictures or posters, such as example speed values, example place names and slogans, was not used [A01].
The Reduced Speed Ahead description names a curb ahead where a curve may have been meant; the fact restates only the slippery-road reason, which is printed plainly [A03].
The reserved parking entry points to a linked title for permit details; that linked page was not followed and no permit process is stated here [A04].
The sentence describing the colors of some disabled access signs is ambiguous on the page, so it is not restated as a fact [A07].
The distances shown on work-ahead and brown destination signs vary by sign, which is isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Wisconsin Motorists Handbook prints 2026 on its front cover and form number BDS126 with 2026 on its back cover; it is a yearly-dated handbook with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
